channel.title: Blueprint AI Studio - Project progress
channel.description: Dated public progress for Blueprint AI Studio, its LMS and From Blueprint to Application.

item.title: The book, reader labs and the next chapter
item.description: The book overview is available on Adaptivearts.ai, and the public reader lab includes CBE and CBE-IX exercises. The blueprintaistudio.app domain currently shows a coming-soon page. Studio and LMS development are the next part of the project; there is no public LMS launch to announce yet.

item.title: Capability boundaries become hands-on exercises
item.description: CBE and CBE-IX profiles, worked examples and interactive labs are published. The Blueprint reader lab connects the two methods to the difference between a rule, authority and effective enforcement.
